correctness.rationale: The increments f(i+1)-f(i) in {0,1} make displacement f(i)-i weakly decreasing with endpoint signs, giving a nonempty fixed integer interval. Iteration traps every point at its nearest fixed endpoint within n steps. Fixing [a,b] forces boundary zero increments and inside ones; exactly max(0,a-2)+max(0,n-b-1) exterior increments are freely binary, and each additional one increases initial image rank by one. Summing locations gives J_n and stable-rank counts; conditional binomial CLT with tight geometric stable-rank tails proves the independent triple limit. Independent enumeration of all such maps and f^n for n<=9 matched exact binomial fiber and normalization. Boundary n=1 and n=2 checked.
